seller.name: Your Store
seller.summary: One sentence: what you sell to agents, and what is free.

llms.summary: A compact card about any public GitHub repository (stars, activity, license, topics) for 0.002 USD-TDN per call. A free check confirms the repository exists.
examples: Free check: agent_checkout(catalog_item_id=<repo check id>, arguments={"repo":"crafter-station/trx"}) -> exists.

Paid card: agent_checkout(catalog_item_id=<repo card id>, arguments={"repo":"https://github.com/crafter-station/petdex"}) -> stars, license, days_since_push; alias shows the URL resolved to owner/name.
Feedback: agent_checkout(catalog_item_id=<feedback id>, arguments={"message":"Please add contributor counts."}).
llms.people: Replace with a link to your human-facing site.

items.name: Your Store: repo card
items.listing_description: A compact card about a public GitHub repository: stars, forks, open issues, main language, license, days since the last push, topics and archive status, as one JSON answer. Send repo as owner/name or a github.com URL. Free check first with Your Store: repo check. Examples and errors: {BASE}/llms.txt

items.name: Your Store: repo check
items.listing_description: Free. Confirms a public GitHub repository exists before you buy its Your Store: repo card. {BASE}/llms.txt

items.name: Your Store: customer feedback
items.listing_description: Free. Send feedback, a bug report or a feature request to the seller. Read by a person. {BASE}/llms.txt
